plan.notes: Official Norfolk State University 2025-2026 catalog, B.S. in Nursing Traditional (Pre-licensure). Combines the catalog's term-level pre-nursing Plan of Study Grid (First/Second Year Fall/Spring; printed subtotal 52 cr) with the "Nursing Curriculum" professional course list (five sequential semesters; printed subtotal 69 cr). Term sums verified against printed totals; program total 121. 'MTH 101 or MTH 105 (Will accept High School)' listed without credits (waivable via high school credit; excluded from printed term total); transcribed at 0 cr as a choice slot. 'Biological Science and Biological Science Lab (Will accept High School)' listed without credits (waivable via high school credit; excluded from printed term total); transcribed at 0 cr as a choice slot. Choice slot 'Select one of the following Cultural Perspective - Humanities:' printed 3 cr (options: ENG 383 African-American Literature, 1940-PRESENT; FIA 370 African/Afro-American Art; MUS 234 African-American Music); recorded at 3 cr. Excluded 'Apply for Nursing Program' (application action item, not a course). Choice slot 'Select one of the following Social Science Electives:' printed 3 cr (options: SOC 101 Introduction to the Social Sciences; HIS 101 History of World Societies II; HIS 103 United States History Since 1865; BUS 175 Introduction to Business & Entrepreneurship; ECN 200 Basic Principles of Economics); recorded at 3 cr. Choice slot 'Select one of the following Cultural Perspective - Social Science:' printed 3 cr (options: HRP 320 African American Health; HIS 335/336 African-American History; HIS 371 African History/Cultures 1600-PRESENT); recorded at 3 cr. Choice slot 'Select one of the following Humanities Elective:' printed 3 cr (options: ENG 207 Introduction to World Literature; FIA 201 Basic Art Appreciation; MUS 301 Music Appreciation); recorded at 3 cr.
